author: Slidebean
description:
That “4K” movie you’re streaming?
It’s probably upscaled from 2K.

And even worse, it’s heavily compressed.

Streaming: 40 Mbps
4K Blu-ray: 144 Mbps

Same resolution.
Very different quality.

Because real image quality isn’t just pixels.
It’s bitrate, color, and detail.

👉 Want the full breakdown? Watch it on our YouTube channel
title: 4K streaming isn’t really 4K
